summary.text: John Wills is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 10, where Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2015, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A U.S. Army veteran who served from 1983 to 2015, he has been speaker pro tempore since 2020.

paragraphs.text: John Wills was born in Sibley, Iowa, and graduated from Sibley High School in 1984.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1983 to 2015.

Wills earned an associate degree in environmental studies from Iowa Lakes Community College in 1987, a bachelor's degree in biology from Northwestern College in 1989, and master's degrees in political science and government and in environmental policy and management from American Military University.

His career experience includes working as a Clean Water Alliance coordinator with the Dickinson Soil and Water Conservation District, and he has been affiliated with the American Legislative Exchange Council.
Wills began serving as speaker pro tempore in 2020.

For 2025-2026 he serves on the Administration and Rules, Commerce, Higher Education, Judiciary, Public Safety, and Ways and Means committees, is vice chair of the Administration Committee, and sits on the Legislative Council.
